head.h1: Mothers Day Catering in Dubai — Menus, Prices and What's Included

opening_paragraph: Mothers Day catering in Dubai from myCHEF is a private-chef service that costs from AED 700 per person. A vetted chef plans the menu, cooks, serves and clears away, so the woman who usually runs the kitchen sits down and is looked after for once. Send the date, guest count and venue and, during our published business hours, you hear back promptly with an itemised proposal to follow.

new_paragraphs: How much does Mothers Day catering cost in Dubai?

From about AED 700 per person, with the final figure set by guest count, menu and how much service you want. Buffet and drop-off sit lowest; plated service runs higher. Send your numbers for an itemised quote.
What is included in Mothers Day catering?
Everything — menu design, a chef cooking on site, the service team, plating and the full clean-up afterwards. You provide the guests; we handle the rest.
How far ahead should I book Mothers Day catering?
A week is usually enough for a small gathering; book earlier for large parties and peak Mothers Day dates, which fill quickly.
Can you cater a Mothers Day brunch at home?
Yes. A private chef cooks in your own kitchen and serves a brunch spread or afternoon tea in your dining room, garden or on the terrace, then clears everything away.
Do you offer afternoon tea for Mothers Day?
Yes. Afternoon tea is one of our most-requested Mothers Day formats — finger sandwiches, warm scones, patisserie and a dessert table, styled for the occasion.
Can you handle dietary requirements?
Yes. Vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free, nut-free and halal menus are all routine. Flag every requirement at quote stage and the menu is built around it.
Do you do corporate Mothers Day catering?
Yes. We deliver corporate Mothers Day catering to offices across Dubai, from a morning pastry spread to a plated team lunch, invoiced to the company.
For mothers day catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

We bring Mothers Day catering to homes right across Dubai, so the celebration happens wherever your family already gathers. A caterer travels to villas in Emirates Hills, Arabian Ranches and Jumeirah, to apartments in Downtown, Dubai Marina, JBR and Business Bay, and out to Palm Jumeirah, Al Barsha and the Hills — mothers day home catering set up in your own dining room, garden or terrace. Prefer somewhere else? The team also caters yachts, private beaches and event spaces on request. Explore related afternoon tea and brunch options, browse all event catering , or see the full range of catering in Dubai .

add_block.new_heading: What is on a Mothers Day menu?
new_paragraphs: Every Mothers Day menu in Dubai is built from scratch around the guest of honour's tastes, but a few formats do the heavy lifting. A long, generous brunch spread is the classic — eggs cooked to order, fresh pastries, seasonal fruit, a hot dish or two and a centrepiece cake. Afternoon tea is the other favourite, with delicate finger sandwiches, warm scones, patisserie and a proper pot of tea. Around those we add grazing boards, canapés, a dessert table and a mocktail or fresh-juice bar for a celebratory feel without alcohol. All mothers day food catering is seasonal and made on the day, and menus flex from light and healthy to full and indulgent. Tell us her favourite dish and the chef will often work it in as the signature course.

add_block.new_heading: When is Mother's Day in the UAE, and what changes for catering?
new_paragraphs: Mother's Day in the UAE falls on 21 March , the spring equinox, and is shared with most of the Arab world — Bahrain, Egypt, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Oman, Qatar and Saudi Arabia among them ( UAE Ministry of Health and Prevention ). Mother's Day 2026 in the UAE is therefore Saturday 21 March, which lands on a weekend and makes lunch the busier booking rather than dinner.

That date matters if your family spans countries. International Mother's Day is not one day: the United Kingdom keeps Mothering Sunday in March on a date that moves with Easter, and the United States marks it on the second Sunday in May. Households with family in both places often mark it twice, and the March booking is the one that fills first in Dubai.

Mother's Day offers in Dubai cluster around hotel brunches and set restaurant menus, which is worth knowing mainly because it is what makes tables scarce that weekend. A private chef booking is priced the same on 21 March as on any other date — the menu, the guest count and the service style set the figure, not the occasion.
